title: Chapter 426: Scoring A Double Score
content:
Chapter 426: Scoring A Double Score

"What!"

When the Supreme Elder of the Mianhe heard this news, his face looked desperate. He was just a list and he would die here.

ah! He was unwilling to give up!

The majestic offensive of the Great Old Ancestor was still spread on the body of the Supreme Elder of the Unknown River, but gradually, the Supreme Elder of the Unknown River no longer blindly defended, but instead fought against the offensive towards the Great Old Ancestor.

Since death is the only ending, I will fight to death and let you lose two layers of skin.

At this time, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River was obviously losing his mind because he was about to die, and his strength had been greatly improved.

A person who has put life and death aside must be terrifying.

Even the Haohan Ancestor was no longer so strong at this moment, and began to retreat slowly to avoid the edge.

If the Supreme Elder of the Underworld River can think rationally, he will know that the words of the Great Ancestor Haohan are unreasonable.

Because he watched the rankings that Haohan Ancestor had won with his own eyes, but the rankings that he defeated were only one down and did not disappear.

Could it be that those people all surrendered when they saw Haohan Ancestor?

It is possible, but the probability is very small. After all, not all those people are making up for the numbers, and there are also a few people with strong heads.

So it is obvious that what Haohan Ancestor said is not completely correct.

boom!

As the battle lasted longer, after the Elder of the Dark River used his peerless killer move at the cost of his life, he died here directly at the cost of injuring the Great Ancestor.

Standing there, the ancestor Haohan gasped and looked at the body of the Supreme Elder of the Dark River, his eyes slightly sunk.

Even though he was strong enough to see the Supreme Elder of the Underworld River, he was still injured in the face of the opponent's death counterattack.

The producer of this list is afraid that the person who plays the list will not have to do his best.

What's even more terrifying is how powerful will the person who can make such a list be?

Just as the ancestor Haohan was pondering, the body of the elder Taishang of the Dark River suddenly began to slowly dissipate, and then a ball of light appeared in front of the ancestor Haohan.

"Congratulations, you are the first to top the combat power list to fight along the way, and you are specially distributed to you with encouragement awards."

The light source dissipated, and an exquisite pill that emitted a faint fragrance and surrounded the nine-patterned lines appeared in front of the vast ancestor.

Seeing this, Haohan Ancestor looked very happy.

Unexpectedly, there was an unexpected joy.

On the outside of the list, everyone saw that the first place in the combat power list had become the vast ancestor.

At this time, a light flashed and the figure of the Supreme Elder of the Dark River appeared in the field.

I saw his face pale and he looked like he was still scared.

"I, I'm still alive."

The Supreme Elder of the Dark River shook his hands, looking incredible.

He now knows that dying inside is not really dead. He will only be weak after coming out and can recover after he is cultivated for a period of time.

But that feeling of death is really too real.

He looked up at the combat power list in front of him again, and he was no longer as confident as he was at the beginning.

And at this moment, another dazzling name appeared on the combat power list and then began to move up.

Chen Wei, a strong man in the human race.

He is also a strong man in the realm of Heavenly Supreme, and he is not an ordinary Heavenly Supreme.

Seeing this, Elder Dark River's eyelids twitched. Could it be? !

After a while, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River disappeared again, and when he opened his eyes again, he appeared in a familiar place.

"grass!"

When the Supreme Elder of the Dark River saw the powerful human race opposite, he couldn't help but curse.

Seeing this, Chen Wei frowned slightly, "Call me, are you looking for death?"

"No, sir, don't misunderstand me. I'm injured now, I'm afraid I can't let you have fun."

The Supreme Elder of the Dark River quickly explained, his face bitter, but he was shocked. The feeling of weakness that he had just been outside had disappeared. After entering here, he returned to his full state.

"What, you want to surrender?"

Chen Wei frowned slightly, and his eyes were filled with contempt when he looked at the Supreme Elder of the Dark River.

Feeling Chen Wei's gaze, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River was silent for a moment when he saw whether he surrendered in front of him.

"Does it surrender?"

The Supreme Elder of the Under River sighed and said, "No."

After all, he is also the top strong man of the clan. Even when facing the unbeatable human powerhouse, he still doesn't want to surrender before the battle.

Seeing this, Chen Wei nodded slightly, "Do your best is my greatest respect for you."

Buzz —

When the battle began, Chen Wei disappeared from the spot instantly.

"The underworld fell from the sky!"

With experience, the Supreme Elder of the Dark River also used his peerless killer move as soon as he came up.

At the beginning, the two of them fought back and forth, but it was obvious that this was just an appearance. In any aspect, Chen Wei's strength overwhelmed the Supreme Elder of the Under River in all aspects.

Elder Dark River used his ultimate move regardless of the consequences, but it only made Chen Wei's clothes slightly dirty, and he couldn't even take a breath.

This is much stronger than the Great Ancestor.

Bang!

Finally, the Supreme Elder of the Under River could not hold on anymore and was knocked away by Chen Wei's blow, and then he no longer had the power to fight back.

One-sided beating.

After a long time, the Supreme Elder of the Under River died here again.

The life force of the Supreme Heaven is indeed strong.

There are also differences between being the Supreme Heavenly Powerful One.

The powerful people of heaven are also divided into earth-grade heavenly supreme, heavenly supreme, holy supreme, and even immortal supreme!

Like Chen Wei, the Supreme Elder of the Under River, they are both of the Heavenly Supreme Power.

This is also the reason why the Supreme Elder of the Dark River was so confident at the beginning. The Supreme Heavenly Plate Heaven really has few opponents in the Chaos Realm.

But the Supreme Elder of the Under River has only just entered the heavenly level, while Chen Wei is about to enter the holy level of Heavenly Supreme.

There is still a big gap between the two.

If Chen Wei really bought the Holy Product Supreme Heaven, then the Supreme Elder of the Dark River would probably not be Chen Wei's one-union enemy.

Outside the combat power list, the figure of the Supreme Elder of the Under River appeared again, and his body was still very weak.

When he came to his senses, his face became very ugly.

He guessed right. As long as those real strong men from the Chaos Realm come here, they will be challenged all the time. As long as they don’t surrender, they will definitely die many times.

Damn it, I wouldn't have jumped out so early if I had known it.

At this time, the news that the list of the Desert City has begun to spread rapidly throughout the Chaos Realm. When those terrifying old monsters who are still in seclusion hear the news, they may soon rush over. At that time, they will be the real demons dancing around.

The human race closest to the deserted city also caused a considerable shock.

Many human strongmen began to report to their ancestors and other powerful people.
